fields.Name: ORD-36 - Payment Deposit
fields.Description: Cash against a scheduled order (golive #239 follow-up, D91). A scheduled company books no value at confirm, so until an instalment is invoiced there is no receivable for cash to clear: money held for something not yet billed is a customer deposit and belongs in the Customer Deposits role. Proves the cascade settles an invoiced instalment before a merely scheduled one whatever the due dates say, that the payment entry credits Accounts Receivable only up to what has been invoiced and Customer Deposits beyond it, that naming a Scheduled instalment is a deposit in full, that refunds (unnamed and named) mirror what the payment booked, that the webhook promotion and two named lines on one payment book correctly, that a deposit and its later application resolve to the same per-product account, that an unlinked Customer Deposits role refuses the payment, that an instalment cannot be advanced to Invoiced except through Orders.IssueInstalmentInvoice, and that an order with no schedule books exactly the payment entry it always did. Also proves the billing worklist filters on having an invoice rather than on dates.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Unnamed cash lands on the invoiced instalment and credits AR alone; cash beyond the invoiced amount splits AR and Customer Deposits; a payment naming a Scheduled instalment credits Customer Deposits in full; refunding either posts the mirror (Dr AR / Dr Customer Deposits / Cr Cash) and returns the schedule to where it was; issuing a prepaid instalment posts the invoice at full value plus Dr Customer Deposits / Cr AR on the same account the deposit used; an unlinked role refuses with nothing written; hand-setting Invoiced is refused naming Orders.IssueInstalmentInvoice; an unscheduled order produces one cash debit and one AR credit; an instalment issued by confirm is not offered by the billing worklist.
